name: Viboplr Community
author: Viboplr
description: Viboplr Community inside the app: a Community tab on every song, album and artist page — like and comment, import shared cue sheets and synced lyrics — plus mixtapes, Subsonic servers opened to members, and publishing your own. Sign in with GitHub to share, like, comment or see shared servers; browsing, playing and importing needs no account.

viewHeader.subtitle: What Viboplr listeners share: songs, albums and artists, mixtapes, and Subsonic servers

assistant.instructions: Viboplr Community shares cue sheets, synced lyrics and mixtapes between users. publish_lyrics sends the synced lyrics Viboplr already has for a song to the community server, under the signed-in user's account. It never takes lyrics from you: to share lyrics you have fixed, save them for the song in Viboplr first. Check with get_lyrics that the song has kind=synced, and only publish when the user asked. It fails, with the reason, when the user isn't signed in (you can't sign in for them), the song has no lyrics, or they are plain.

tools.name: publish_lyrics
tools.description: Publish the synced lyrics Viboplr has for a song to Viboplr Community (an update if already shared). Returns { status: "published" | "updated", id, url }. Needs the user signed in to Community; fails when the song has no synced lyrics.
